In need of a good game suggestion, show the world what u can muster /v/RPG !

Are you looking for a table top RPG, with simple mechanics where planning, and clever tactics along with great role playing will trump a statistically better character with no imagination? "Within the Ring of Fire" is this, as well as probably the most darkest of dark fantasy RPGs I have ever red. It's so dark, and only slightly edgy!

If you're looking for a more MMO like RPG, Pathfinder is the way to go. Not only is it the most popular type of RPG, but the character variety you can have is ridiculous, with an emphasis on combat and dungeon exploration, you can roll with so many different classes in a plethera of ways. Hell, the basic Fighter can be radically different depending on what weapons he chooses, and how he uses them. Wizards can be everything from Crowd Control, to Long range Damage, zombie witch doctors, ect. Although, the community does have a very narrow mindset of how things should be As in "Melee fighters should always use Greatsword, Wizards should always crowd control, ect. ect.". That's not to say that they don't have any merit to their reasoning, but some people do have a hive mind mentality on how things are with Pathfinder.

The best part of all, The SRD has pretty much everything for free! If you want to not dance around copyright all that much, Pazio also has their rules put up online for free!. And there are multiple ways to have a character sheet online as well.

And lastly, Roll20 is the place to get your TTRPG gaming on, atleast online. It may not have the greatest players, or the greatest GMs, but it's damn well the most popular one! If you want to find something more niche, I'm sure you can find other ways to game.

And that's it, hope you find and awesome gaming group! Within the Ring of Fire, and Pathfinder are at the opposite sides of the spectrum when it comes to how far RPGs can differ, but those are my two recommendations for Table top RPGs.
